lemma: Let H be generated by r points whose images are independent in a product of E(F_p)/ell E(F_p), and suppose E(Q)[ell]=0. If ell Q=sum a_i P_i, reduction forces every a_i divisible by ell. Hence ell(Q-sum(a_i/ell)P_i)=0, and the torsion hypothesis gives Q in H. Thus H is ell-saturated in E(Q).
